description: Complete Iteration 1 Vertical Slice: OpenCode ACP integration and end-to-end reproducibility

functional: Agent server processes messages through real OpenCode ACP instead of mock responses
Full EM -> Engineer -> QA loop completes with real model invocations
End-to-end run is reproducible across at least 2 consecutive runs
acceptance_criteria.solid: The implementation adheres to SOLID principles by isolating OpenCode ACP communication behind a dedicated client module separate from the HTTP server.
acceptance_criteria.yagni_kiss: The implementation adheres to YAGNI and KISS by leveraging the existing opencode CLI subprocess interface without introducing a new transport layer.
acceptance_criteria.testing: Well-designed unit tests cover ACP client lifecycle and full E2E loop with real model, with minimum unit test coverage of 80%+ for touched modules.

context_rationale: These files define the agent server, configuration, entry point, container setup, and OpenCode CLI bootstrap needed for ACP integration.

tasks.description: Implement agent/acp_client.py module that wraps the opencode CLI subprocess for model inference

functional: ACPClient initializes with role, model, system prompt path, and workspace root from AgentConfig
ACPClient.process_message() spawns opencode subprocess with system prompt and user message, captures stdout JSON output
ACPClient.process_message() parses the JSON response and returns output string, tokens_used, and latency_ms
ACPClient handles subprocess timeout gracefully, raising a descriptive exception after a configurable deadline
ACPClient.cleanup() terminates any lingering subprocess on shutdown
acceptance_criteria.solid: The implementation adheres to SOLID principles by encapsulating all subprocess lifecycle and I/O logic within ACPClient, keeping the HTTP server purely responsible for routing.
acceptance_criteria.yagni_kiss: The implementation adheres to YAGNI and KISS by using subprocess.run with a timeout rather than implementing a custom protocol or persistent connection.
acceptance_criteria.testing: Well-designed unit tests cover subprocess success, timeout, crash, and JSON parse failure paths, with minimum unit test coverage of 80%+ for touched modules.

tasks.context_rationale: server.py shows the current mock integration point, config.py provides the parameters, opencode-setup.sh shows how opencode is invoked, and Dockerfile shows available binaries.

tasks.description: Add unit tests for ACPClient covering subprocess lifecycle, timeout, and error handling

functional: Test mocks subprocess.run to verify ACPClient passes correct args (model, system prompt, message)
Test verifies ACPClient raises on subprocess timeout after configured deadline
Test verifies ACPClient raises on non-zero subprocess exit code with descriptive message
Test verifies ACPClient raises on invalid JSON from subprocess stdout
Test verifies ACPClient.cleanup() terminates lingering subprocess
acceptance_criteria.solid: The implementation adheres to SOLID principles by testing ACPClient in isolation through subprocess mocking rather than requiring a live model.
acceptance_criteria.yagni_kiss: The implementation adheres to YAGNI and KISS by using standard unittest.mock.patch for subprocess.run, requiring no test infrastructure beyond pytest.
acceptance_criteria.testing: Well-designed unit tests cover subprocess success, timeout, crash, and JSON parse failure paths, with minimum unit test coverage of 80%+ for touched modules.

tasks.context_rationale: server.py shows the current structure the ACPClient will follow; test_e2e.py shows the existing test patterns to follow.

tasks.description: Update end-to-end test to run with real OpenCode ACP and verify reproducibility across 2 consecutive runs

functional: E2E test launches agent servers with _mock_mode=False against a reachable model endpoint
Full EM -> Engineer -> QA loop completes and all expected events (TaskCreated, PlanningCompleted, ImplementationCompleted, ReviewPassed, TaskCompleted) are recorded
Test runs the full loop twice consecutively and confirms both runs reach TaskCompleted
Distinct model identifiers are recorded per role in the event log across both runs
acceptance_criteria.solid: The implementation adheres to SOLID principles by isolating the reproducibility assertion logic into a reusable test helper function.
acceptance_criteria.yagni_kiss: The implementation adheres to YAGNI and KISS by extending the existing test_e2e.py fixture infrastructure with a non-mock variant rather than writing a separate test file.
acceptance_criteria.testing: Well-designed unit tests cover the real-model E2E loop and reproducibility assertion, with minimum unit test coverage of 80%+ for touched modules.

tasks.context_rationale: test_e2e.py contains the existing E2E test infrastructure to extend; server.py and config.py provide the mock mode toggle needed for the real model run.

tasks.description: Wire ACPClient into AgentServer._process_message() and disable mock mode via config flag

functional: AgentServer initializes ACPClient with config on construction
_process_message() delegates to ACPClient when _mock_mode is False, returning real model output
_mock_mode defaults to True but can be set to False via a MOCK_MODE environment variable or AgentConfig field
WorkResponse includes accurate tokens_used and latency_ms from ACPClient
Server gracefully degrades: if ACPClient raises, HTTP 500 is returned with the error detail
acceptance_criteria.solid: The implementation adheres to SOLID principles by keeping ACPClient as a swappable dependency, allowing mock mode to coexist for testing.
acceptance_criteria.yagni_kiss: The implementation adheres to YAGNI and KISS by replacing the existing NotImplementedError branch with a single ACPClient call, adding no new abstraction layers.
acceptance_criteria.testing: Well-designed unit tests cover happy path delegation, error propagation, and mock mode toggle, with minimum unit test coverage of 80%+ for touched modules.

tasks.context_rationale: server.py contains the _process_message method to modify and the _mock_mode flag; config.py needs the new MOCK_MODE field.
